request: a systemd usage knowledge corpus (practical operator-focused)

outline.scope: Unit files and systemctl in practice: unit types, enable/disable/mask verbs, lifecycle states, WantedBy, unit file lookup order
journald in practice: journalctl filtering, persistent journal, structured fields, rate limiting, log forwarding
Timers instead of cron: OnCalendar/OnUnitActiveSec, Persistent=, randomized delays, timer debugging
Drop-ins and overrides: systemctl edit, drop-in directory semantics, lex-sort ordering trap, daemon-reload discipline
Service sandboxing: ProtectSystem/ProtectHome, DynamicUser, systemd-analyze security scores, practical hardening workflow
networkd + resolved usage: .network/.netdev/.link files, networkctl, DNS/mDNS config, debugging connectivity
Resource control: slices, CPUQuota/MemoryMax/IOWeight, systemd-cgtop, delegation for containers
Boot analysis and targets: systemd-analyze blame/critical-chain, targets vs runlevels, rescue/emergency modes, debugging stuck boots
